composition_subtypes.role: Sort intervals primarily by right endpoint to maximize remaining options for later intervals
Iterate sorted intervals and greedily assign the smallest available day in each interval

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort intervals by right endpoint to enable greedy assignment of the earliest free day within each interval.
payload.rationale: The solution first sorts intervals using a custom key (right endpoint, left, index) to order them optimally. Then it greedily assigns the smallest available day to each interval, a classic interval scheduling pattern.
